notes.content:
Added new items:

Added three new symptoms:

 Difficulty breathing

notes.title: Update January 15, 2025
notes.content:
1. Fixed non-working ability to manually place medications in the basket while it's on the counter.
2. Default music has been added to the audio player. Delete it and copy your .mp3 files to \Users\user\Documents\RealPharmacySimulator\mp3 folder to remove it completely. While your files are in this folder, copying will not occur.
3. The audio player can now be picked up.
4. Fixed a ceiling lamp that wasn't responding to the switch.
5. Added to the list of goods for sale:
- Thermometer
- DermaclearActive
6. Added two new symptoms

notes.title: Patch of January 13, 2025
notes.content:
Fixed UI text that was not displayed when hovering over plant seeds.
Fixed UI text that covered part of the camera when using the terminal and picking up medical prescriptions.
Fixed a bug where upon leveling up, the text displaying the current day name was replaced with the level value (:D)
The water bottle now fills up correctly again.

notes.title: Performance improvements, migration to URP, and other updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone! New patch!
[olist]
 I've rebuilt the entire game using URP. Performance has significantly improved, though graphics quality took a slight hit.
 The starting location has been redesigned. This is needed for future plans - I want to build a small town where players can buy property and set up either a farm or pharmaceutical production in the basement.
 The interface has been redesigned.
 Pause and settings menus have been redesigned.
 Character controller has been replaced with a more realistic one.
 Experience system and character levels have been implemented (needs testing, please report any issues via DM).
 Two new visitor templates have been added.

notes.title: Performance improvements, migration to URP, and other updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone! New patch!

[olist]
 I've rebuilt the entire game using URP. Performance has significantly improved, though graphics quality took a slight hit.
 The starting location has been redesigned. This is needed for future plans - I want to build a small town where players can buy property and set up either a farm or pharmaceutical production in the basement.
 The interface has been redesigned.
 Pause and settings menus have been redesigned.
 Character controller has been replaced with a more realistic one.
 Experience system and character levels have been implemented (needs testing, please report any issues via DM).
 Two new visitor templates have been added.
[/olist]

What's next?
Top priority: complete the plant growing system and the creation of tinctures, pills, and ointments from dried medicinal plants. I also plan to add customization options for naming your own medicinal products (and packaging customization).

Production process:

 Laboratory with various equipment (distillation unit, pill press, dryer)
 Recipes can be discovered through experimentation or found in-game
 Quality depends on herb freshness and process accuracy


Gameplay mechanics:

 Different herbs provide different effects
 Combining herbs can enhance effects or create new properties
 Preparation time affects effectiveness
 Incorrect preparation may result in side effects

Second priority:
[olist]
"Town" location where players can buy their own house with a yard and garden
Continued development of story mode
[/olist]
